description: WP File Manager before 8.0.7 contains a file upload restriction bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to upload arbitrary PHP files by exploiting a misconfigured elFinder connector in file_folder_manager.php where an empty uploadDeny list causes allowPutMime() to unconditionally return true, bypassing the uploadAllow restriction. Attackers can upload a .php file directly or upload it under an allowed filename and then rename it via the rename connector command, achieving remote code execution as the web server user.
